title: A Missing Caravan
description: A small supply caravan was expected two days ago but never arrived. Its owner fears the wagons have been lost somewhere along the forest road.
objective: Follow the caravan's route, locate the missing wagons, and discover what happened to the drivers.
complication: The caravan was not attacked. Its drivers abandoned the wagons after finding a familiar road leading somewhere it should not.
reward: 25 gp per character and a free night's lodging at a local inn.

title: The Lost Heirloom
description: An elderly dwarf has lost a silver pendant that belonged to his late wife. He believes he dropped it somewhere in the marketplace.
objective: Find the missing pendant and return it to Bromli.
complication: A young street child found the pendant and refuses to return it because they believe it can be sold to feed their family.
reward: 10 gp, a handcrafted tool, and the dwarf's gratitude.

title: The Unquiet Cemetery
description: The cemetery groundskeeper reports strange noises coming from an old mausoleum. Several graves have also been found disturbed.
objective: Investigate the mausoleum, determine the cause of the disturbances, and ensure the burial grounds are safe.
complication: The apparent grave robbers are actually two desperate siblings searching for their mother's hidden belongings. Something else has been moving beneath the mausoleum.
reward: 35 gp, two healing potions, and permission to examine the cemetery's old records.

title: A Delivery of Urgency
description: An apothecary needs a sealed package delivered to a healer in a neighboring village before nightfall.
objective: Deliver the sealed package to the village healer without opening or damaging it.
complication: The package contains medicine intended for a sick child, but a local official insists it must be inspected before leaving town.
reward: 15 gp, a healer's kit, and three doses of common medicinal herbs.

title: The Broken Road
description: Travelers have been avoiding a stretch of road after repeated attacks by armed outlaws. The town's merchants are losing valuable trade.
objective: Make the road safe enough for caravans to travel again by confronting or negotiating with the outlaws.
complication: The outlaws are former caravan guards who were never paid by their employer. Their leader is willing to negotiate, but only if the employer is held accountable.
reward: 60 gp, a set of travel supplies, and free passage with a merchant caravan.

title: The Bell Beneath the Earth
description: Several townsfolk have reported hearing a bell ringing from underground. A frightened laborer claims the sound is coming from beneath an abandoned building.
objective: Investigate the source of the ringing and determine whether it poses a danger to the surrounding residents.
complication: The sound is connected to an old sealed chamber. Opening it may reveal something valuable, but the ringing grows louder whenever someone approaches.
reward: 45 gp, an old silver charm, and access to Perrin's collection of unusual tools.

title: The Noble's Disappearance
description: A young noble has vanished after leaving a family gathering. Their relatives want the matter handled quietly to avoid a public scandal.
objective: Locate the missing noble and bring them safely home, or discover why they disappeared.
complication: The noble deliberately ran away to escape an arranged marriage and refuses to return unless their family agrees to end the arrangement.
reward: 75 gp, an invitation to the noble's household, and a favor owed by the family.

title: The Last Watch
description: A remote watchtower has stopped sending its regular signals. The guard captain wants someone to investigate before the surrounding roads become vulnerable.
objective: Reach the watchtower, determine why communication stopped, and restore its signal.
complication: The tower's guards are alive but refusing to return because something in the nearby hills has been imitating their voices.
reward: 60 gp, a shield or martial weapon from the guardhouse stores, and official recognition from the town watch.

title: A Matter of Reputation
description: Two rival merchants are accusing each other of selling counterfeit goods. Their dispute is disrupting the marketplace and drawing increasingly hostile crowds.
objective: Investigate the accusations, identify the source of the counterfeit goods, and settle the dispute before it escalates.
complication: Both merchants have knowingly sold inferior goods, but neither is responsible for the latest counterfeits. A third party is exploiting their rivalry.
reward: 40 gp, a valuable merchant contact, and a discount at several marketplace stalls.

title: The Shattered Shrine
description: A small roadside shrine has been desecrated. Its caretaker fears the damage is connected to a series of strange occurrences in the surrounding woods.
objective: Examine the shrine, identify who damaged it, and recover the missing ceremonial object.
complication: The object was taken by someone attempting to prevent a ritual from being completed. The caretaker knows more about the ritual than he initially admits.
reward: 50 gp, a holy symbol, and a blessing that grants advantage on one saving throw against being frightened.

title: The Silent Witness
description: A traveling merchant was robbed outside town. A stable hand claims to have witnessed the attack but refuses to speak about what happened.
objective: Convince the witness to share what they saw and identify the people responsible for the robbery.
complication: The witness recognizes one of the attackers as a guard who once protected their family. They fear retaliation if they speak.
reward: 35 gp, a healing potion, and the guard's assistance with future legal matters.

title: The Hollow Harvest
description: Farmers near the edge of the forest report that their crops are rotting overnight. The affected plants have strange black markings along their roots.
objective: Investigate the affected fields, identify the source of the corruption, and find a way to stop it spreading.
complication: The corruption appears to respond to sound. A nearby abandoned shrine contains a damaged bell whose vibrations worsen the spreading blight.
reward: 80 gp, a pouch of rare seeds, and a supply of healing herbs.

title: The Prisoner's Bargain
description: A captured outlaw offers information about a hidden cache in exchange for reduced punishment. The guard captain does not trust the prisoner's intentions.
objective: Verify the prisoner's information, locate the hidden cache, and determine whether the bargain should be honored.
complication: The cache belongs to a group of displaced families who were forced to steal to survive. Returning everything to the authorities may leave them destitute.
reward: 50 gp, a choice of one piece of adventuring equipment, and a possible contact among the local outcasts.

title: The Masked Gathering
description: A wealthy patron invites the party to attend a private masked gathering after hearing of their recent exploits. The host claims an important guest needs discreet protection.
objective: Attend the gathering, identify the guest requiring protection, and ensure they leave safely.
complication: Several guests wear identical masks, and the person being protected may not be the person the host claims. The party must determine who is telling the truth.
reward: 100 gp, fine clothing, and an invitation to future private gatherings.

title: The Road That Wasn't There
description: A scout returning from the forest reports discovering a road that appeared overnight. It leads to an old stone structure that cannot be found on any known map.
objective: Follow the scout's directions, investigate the road and stone structure, and return with an accurate account of what lies beyond.
complication: The road does not remain in the same place. The structure appears differently to each traveler, and one member of the scouting party insists they have visited it before despite never having left town.
reward: 125 gp, two potions of healing, and a rare map of the surrounding region.
